title: EMEA GA launch pack — internal enablement and announcement drafts
body:
Purpose and context:
This pack is the go-to-market (GTM) messaging and enablement bundle for the EMEA General Availability (GA) of Redwood Hosted API + optional Dedicated capacity in EU regions. It is intended for Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, and Marketing to drive a coordinated launch across PR, demand gen, and enterprise motion.

Top-line product positioning (single-line):
Reliable, low-latency LLM inference in-region—Redwood GA in EMEA: predictable performance, cost controls, and enterprise-grade controls without rewriting your stack.

Audience segments and key personas:
- AI/ML Platform Leads (mid-market & enterprise): care about throughput guarantees, VPC/private options, and auditability (logs, KMS).
- Product Engineering (startups/scaleups): want plug-and-play API, low latency for chat UX, and competitive per-token economics.
- Security & Compliance stakeholders: need region residency, SOC/ISO signals, support for BYOK/KMS and private deployments.
- Platform/Infra buyers evaluating reserved GPU capacity: interested in Dedicated contracts and predictable unit economics.

Primary messaging pillars (3):
1) Predictable performance in-region: GA includes EU zones with dedicated capacity options and documented latency SLOs. Callout: we publish model-level performance profiles and typical p50/p95 across seq lengths.
2) Cost + control levers: batching, KV caching, and quantization-ready profiles reduce per-token cost without sacrificing latency — plus reserved capacity for predictable spend.
3) Enterprise-ready governance: private control plane, KMS integrations, audit logs, and regional data residency.

Differentiated proof points to surface in sales conversations:
- Benchmarks: our p95 token latency on 2k context Llama-like models in eu-west is XX ms (internal doc link).
- Case study teaser: early beta customer (FinReg startup) saw 22% token-cost reduction after adopting KV prefix cache + recommended batching config.
- Rollout controls: canary and A/B rollouts with automatic fallback to alternate model variants to avoid downtime.

Competitor snapshot (quick notes for SEs):
- Major managed endpoints (CloudA, CloudB): strong infra scale but limited model-level controls and higher per-token markup; typically no built-in KV caching.
- API-only LLM providers (VendorX): simpler dev UX but limited enterprise features (VPC/analytics) and less transparent performance benchmarks.
- Self-hosted inference runtimes (OSS and vendor-managed): lower raw cost at scale but longer time-to-value, higher ops burden.

Rebuttal playbook / objection handling bullets:
- "We can self-host cheaper": validate time-to-delivery, ops headcount, and risk (SLAs, observability). Offer cost modeling with Redwood Optimize scenario.
- "Latency concerns for Europe": share in-region p95 numbers and Dedicated capacity options; offer a joint perf-testing workshop.
- "Security/compliance": highlight private control plane and KMS integrations; propose NDA + compliance review call.

Announcement drafts (editable snippets):
- Press/blog headline (short): Redwood brings low-latency, enterprise-grade LLM inference to EMEA with GA and Dedicated capacity.
- Blog intro paragraph (marketing): Today Redwood Inference launches general availability across EMEA, providing developers and platform teams with in-region LLM inference that balances latency, cost, and governance. Customers can choose hosted API for fast onboarding or Dedicated capacity for predictable throughput and regional isolation.
- Customer email (short): Hi {Name}, We’re excited to announce Redwood’s EMEA GA—now available in eu-west and eu-central. If you’re evaluating options for in-region inference, we can schedule a perf test and cost assessment tailored to your workload.
- Social post (X/LinkedIn): GA in EMEA! 🇪🇺 Faster, cheaper, and more secure LLM inference—now with Dedicated capacity in EU regions. Book a demo: {shortlink} #inference #aiops #mlplatform

Internal enablement checklist (for sales/SEs):
- Read the detailed perf benchmarks (link in linked_artifacts).
- Run the quick perf test script with the prospect on eu-west endpoints (SOP in Confluence).
- Prepare customer-specific cost scenario using Optimize workbook (shared template).
- Review security slide deck + KMS integration checklist before compliance calls.
- If prospect needs on-prem/private, loop in Solutions Engineering + Private Deployments team (eng-private-deployments).

One-pager battlecard (TL;DR for reps):
- Use case fit: live chat/assistant, search/reranking, batch embedding pipelines.
- Win themes: in-region latency SLOs, transparent unit economics, Dedicated contracts.
- Pricing anchors: hosted per-token rates (starter), Dedicated monthly commit tiers and burst pricing (see pricing spreadsheet).
- Close signal: prospect asks for regional residency, predictable throughput, or audit logs.

Launch timeline & owners (high level):
- Nov 2025: Beta feedback consolidation (complete) — owner: Product-hosted-api.
- Dec 2025–Jan 2026: Marketing creative + PR embargo prep — owner: Marketing.
- Feb 2026: Sales enablement + enablement webinars — owner: GTM.
- Mar 2026: Public GA announcement & customer outreach — owner: GTM + Marketing.

Key metrics to track post-launch (first 90 days):
- Signups from EMEA and activation rate on eu endpoints.
- Number of Dedicated deals initiated and expected ARR.
- Average p95 latency by model family and region.
- Cost-savings cases surfaced via Optimize recommendations.

FAQ (short):
Q: Do we support BYOK for EMEA?
A: Yes, KMS integrations are supported; private deployment option also available for stricter requirements.

Q: What models are available at GA?
A: Catalog includes Redwood-curated open LMs and selected quantized variants; full list in product catalog link.

Q: How do customers move from Hosted to Dedicated?
A: Standard migration with capacity planning workshop. SEs should open internal ticket with infra and solutions-eng and use migration checklist.

Next steps (immediate):
- Feedback round: solicit edits from Sales leadership and Solutions Eng by EOD next Tuesday (link to PR).
- Prepare two 30-minute enablement sessions for reps and SEs during week of Mar 2.

Notes / open questions (working):
- Need updated pricing anchors for Dedicated (pricing spreadsheet owner: Finance) — ACTION: Priya to confirm by 2026-02-21.
- Confirm final benchmark table and publish to the public docs (owner: Applied ML).

Slack/links to use in collateral: #gtm-emea, #solutions-eng, #prod-hosted-api.

Drafts and editable assets are in the linked GitHub and Confluence pages above. Use this pack as the canonical internal summary; copy/paste the announcement snippets into campaigns but coordinate on timing with the PR/Comms lead.

Signed-off-by: Sofia Ramirez (PMM, GTM)
